description:
It is midnight. Clyde made a strict holiday budget. Bernie keeps handing things into the room, and the delivery box keeps yelling "add to cart."
One heated blanket later, nobody is safe. Not even Clyde.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #holidayshopping
tiktok_caption: add to cart? it's midnight and the budget is crying #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #holidayshopping

lines.text: It is midnight. We have a budget. Nobody is buying anything.
Of course not. I'm just holding things up. Near the camera.
A heated blanket. With sleeves.
Add to cart!
Who said that?
Winston. I am the box. I live by the door. I deliver dreams.
You deliver bills.
Bills are just dreams with a due date.
Clyde, it's a blanket that hugs you back.
I hug you back.
You hug like a man carrying a couch up the stairs.
That is called support.
Next. A pizza oven for the backyard.
We burn toast. In a toaster. That has one button.
Add to cart!
Stop doing that.
I cannot. I am cardboard. I was born excited.
Add to bowl.
The dog talks now?
Only after midnight. And only about bowls.
He brought something too. Show Daddy.
One sock. Yours. Slightly used. By me.
Add to cart!
You cannot buy my own sock.
Then it is a gift. I wrapped it. In my mouth.
Okay. Rules. Nothing big. Nothing loud. Nothing that plugs in.
A reindeer. Inflatable. Twelve feet tall.
That is big, loud, and it plugs in.
It also sings. When people walk by.
We live next to a bus stop.
Add to cart! Express shipping!
Express? Since when do we pay for express?
Since the reindeer asked. He seemed in a hurry.
Clyde, you're doing the face.
This is my budget face.
Looks like his sneeze face.
Last one, I promise. A recliner.
No.
With a little fridge in the arm.
No.
And it massages your back while you nap.
Add to cart.
Oh, he said it. The budget man said it.
The budget has a fridge now. Things change.
Okay. Checkout. Winston, what's the total?
Funny thing about that.
You already own all of it.
What?
Last November. Same night. Same blanket. Same reindeer. It is all in the garage.
We have a twelve foot singing reindeer in the garage?
Two. You ordered express. Twice.
I sleep in the pizza oven. It is very cozy.
How do you know all this?
Because I am last year's box. I never left. Nobody recycles me.
And the recliner with the fridge?
Also in the garage. Your brother Lenny lives in it now.
That's where Lenny went?
Since Thanksgiving. He says hi. He has snacks in the arm.
So the budget is fine. We spent nothing.
We spent nothing this year. Last year we spent everything.
That's last year's problem. I love that guy.
Can we go see the reindeer? I want to bark at it.
Fine. Everybody to the garage. And nobody touches the phone.
Okay. One more thing, though.
A bigger garage.
Add to cart!
